text:
Type: walnut veneer TV bench on legs
Use: holding a TV and media devices, storing games and records behind doors; living room, family room
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: walnut veneer with a natural finish, solid wood legs and base frame
Colors: warm medium walnut brown
Shape: long low cabinet with three flush handleless doors showing rich grain, slim overhanging top, separate wooden base frame on four square legs, sleek and elongated, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, refined, elegant, calm
Goes with: white or sage walls, wool rugs, brass or black accents; mid-century, Scandinavian or modern living rooms

product.name: STOCKHOLM
product.description: The TV bench in walnut veneer with legs of solid ash brings a warm, natural feeling to your room.
